text:
incident-bot: PAGE: HIGH-SEV model-quality-regression detected for tenant acme-corp (dedicated pool dp-42). Automated evals show ~18% drop in quality score vs baseline; pattern: increased hallucinations and factual errors. Triggered alert at 2026-03-14T21:00:00Z. @emily (oncall) you are now paged.
emily (oncall): ack — looking. any idea if this is pool-wide or tenant-specific?
sarah (ml-eng): initial check — looks like it's isolated to acme-corp traffic on dp-42. We rolled a quantization profile change last night (q4f32 -> q4a8-optim) targeted at dp-42 for cost reduction; rollout completed ~12h ago.
emily (oncall): good, isolation helps. what's the measured delta?
sarah (ml-eng): automated evals: baseline quality score 0.91 -> current 0.74 on our SMOKE set for ACME prompt suite. Token-level differences show softer probabilities on named entities, more hallucinations. Latency P95 unchanged (~80ms).
emily (oncall): ok — sounds like quant profile regression. raj can you confirm that dp-42 only serves acme-corp?
raj (infra): confirmed — dp-42 is a dedicated pool for acme-corp, no other tenants. Networking and routing rules show no cross-tenant traffic.
emily (oncall): propose immediate mitigation: revert quant profile for dp-42 to previous q4f32 profile and pin model to previous non-quantized variant until we validate. Need deploy approval and rollback commands.
sarah (ml-eng): agreed. Steps: 1) revert quant profile 2) pin model variant to redwood-mini-3b-fp16-v1 for dp-42 3) warm cache / run quick evals 4) notify customer and support. I have a ready revert command.
emily (oncall): paste commands please.
sarah (ml-eng): here — internal CLI (rictl) commands:
```
# revert quant profile on pool
rictl pools apply-quant --pool dp-42 --profile q4f32 --force --reason "emergency revert: acme quality regression"
# pin model to previous variant
rictl pools pin-model --pool dp-42 --model redwood-mini-3b --version redwood-mini-3b-fp16-v1
# trigger cache warm and smoke evals
rictl jobs run-eval --pool dp-42 --eval-suite acme-smoke --wait
```
emily (oncall): thanks. raj can you run the first two and report progress?
raj (infra): running now. executing apply-quant...
deploy-bot: Deploy started: apply-quant profile=q4f32 pool=dp-42 user=raj job_id=job-7891
raj (infra): apply-quant finished: SUCCESS. Next pin-model...
deploy-bot: Deploy started: pin-model model=redwood-mini-3b version=redwood-mini-3b-fp16-v1 pool=dp-42 user=raj job_id=job-7892
raj (infra): pin-model finished: SUCCESS. Model traffic should now route to the pinned variant.
emily (oncall): running smoke evals now. Jules please draft a customer message for ACME Ops indicating we've reverted and are monitoring. Mention potential temporary degradation in cost perf and timeline to validate.
jules (support): drafting: "Hi ACME Ops — we detected a model quality regression affecting your instance on our dedicated pool dp-42 after a quantization update. We've reverted the quantization profile and pinned the model back to the previous variant. Our automated checks are running; we expect to confirm recovery within ~15 minutes. No action required on your side; we'll notify once validation completes. Apologies for the disruption." Want me to send now?
acme-corp-ops: thank you for the quick action. We'll hold off any rollout testing for the next hour. Please let us know when it's safe.
emily (oncall): go ahead send now, include incident ref INC-2026-315555.
jules (support): sent.
raj (infra): smoke evals running...
deploy-bot: Job complete: job-7893 (eval) status=PASS metrics=quality:0.89,latency_p95:82ms
sarah (ml-eng): metrics look back to ~baseline (0.89 vs 0.91 baseline). I'll run a few targeted prompts (names/finance/legal) and post samples.
sarah (ml-eng): sample prompt test1: previous output had hallucinated a regulatory clause. re-run now... new output aligns with baseline.
emily (oncall): monitoring dashboards show quality metric trending back up for dp-42. No spillover to other pools.
acme-corp-ops: we see improvements on our side too. thanks. Do you know root cause?
sarah (ml-eng): likely quantization edge-case with q4a8-optim on this model architecture with ACME's prompt distribution (high factuality constraints). We'll triage and block that profile for dp-42 until deeper analysis.
emily (oncall): action items: 1) create incident record with timeline and attach eval diffs (sarah) 2) block q4a8-optim for dp-42 and similar enterprise pools (raj) 3) coordinate postmortem and regression test (sarah+jules) 4) follow-up with ACME in 24h with detailed findings (jules). I'm handing off overnight monitoring to raj (oncall handoff). Raj, you have full context.
emily (oncall): handing off to @raj — I am signing out in 20.
raj (infra): ack handoff. I'll set an alert for quality drop >5% and check in hourly.
sarah (ml-eng): I'll open a model regression ticket linking the quant profile change: MRQ-522, and add eval artifacts and sample diffs. Also will run a controlled A/B locally to reproduce.
jules (support): I'll follow up ACME with a short post-incident note once we have the postmortem draft.
emily (oncall): closing the active page. Incident status: mitigated, customer impacted (ACME) but service restored to expected quality after revert. Follow-ups assigned. :white_check_mark:
incident-bot: PAGE CLOSED: incident_id=INC-2026-315555 status=mitigated closed_by=emily timestamp=3155550480
raj (infra): leaving notes in the incident tracker. If anything regresses ping here and I'll re-escalate.
sarah (ml-eng): quick note: do NOT re-run q4a8-optim on any dedicated pools until we have a targeted test harness for ACME-like prompt distributions. we'll push a safe rollout plan next week.
emily (oncall): thanks everyone. great coordination.
